text.en: Money from the government that never has to be paid back.
A plan that pays the owner back if the business makes a loss.
A loan to buy a house or land, with something valuable as security.
An agreement between two shops to sell the same goods at one fixed price.

explanation.en: A mortgage is a special type of loan used to buy a house or land, with something valuable kept as security. Oberoi mortgaged his wife's jewellery to buy his first hotel.

hints.en: Think about what Oberoi gave as security to get the money for the hotel.
